text: Enter a ward note once and have it automatically sent to both EpicCare and Sensus systems
Select a patient from a live ward list that updates every two minutes, with automatic filling of patient name and MRN
Auto-populate the observation time with the current time, allowing manual edits if needed
Autosave nurse's note instantly while typing to prevent data loss from crashes or interruptions
Display a green tick icon when a note has successfully synced to both EpicCare and Sensus
Show a yellow pending icon with tooltip for notes still attempting to sync, distinguishing temporary delays from failures
Show a red warning icon with a clear message when a note fails to sync after retry attempts
Retry sending failed notes silently every 10 seconds for up to 5 minutes before showing failure status
Block saving a note if no patient is selected, showing a red warning and highlighting the patient field
Allow saving notes for patients no longer on the ward with a one-click confirmation and a yellow warning
Provide a 'Save and Send' button that sends the note to both systems without extra submission steps
Prevent editing of sent notes; corrections must be entered as new tagged notes marked 'Correction'
Maintain a 'Pending Notes' tab listing all unsent notes with red warnings and patient/time details
Allow nurses to manually retry sending pending notes from the 'Pending Notes' tab
Ensure notes are never deleted from the system to preserve audit trails
Encrypt all patient data in transit and at rest; do not store unencrypted patient data locally on devices
Require users on tablets to log out and lock the device when stepping away
Handle bursts of activity with at least 20 concurrent users without performance degradation
Integrate with EpicCare and Sensus using existing interface specifications provided by IT
Provide clear visual and textual feedback for note sync status to support nurse confidence and reduce errors
